analysis: CHANGELOG.md is documentation only (modified, mode 100644 unchanged). The only addition is the v0.9.21 candidate section (head lines 6-12), which states that the tag is unpublished and that publication is a separate step. It covers one fixed item: keeping startup health-check timings out of throughput estimates and bootstrapping loaded-model measurements with bounded, preemptible runs. That is a routing and performance-estimation change with no visible effect on authentication, attestation, encryption, billing or data exposure. Related threat entries are T-007 (provider output integrity) and the routing and availability areas. The claim of 'preemptible' measurements cannot be verified because no source files were supplied. A later pass should check, if the code is available, that the bootstrap measurements neither use real consumer prompts nor leak data across tenants. They should also not touch prefix-cache state (T-041) and not influence App Attest authorization, the TB-011 final-dispatch checks, or billing. The supplied text describes no such effect. The remaining changelog content is pre-existing text, and I raised no findings on it. Coverage is limited to the two changelog units, because the code behind the v0.9.21 entry was not supplied.
